# Pinned build toolchain for .github/scripts/check-reproducible-build.py.
#
# sdk/pyproject.toml declares `requires = ["hatchling"]` with no version, so a
# plain `python -m build` uses whatever hatchling is newest that day. The
# reproducibility check installs exactly these versions into each of its two
# throwaway virtual environments instead, so the only thing that can differ
# between the two builds is the build itself.
#
# Every line must be an exact `==` pin (the script refuses anything else), and
# every name in [build-system].requires must appear here.
#
# To refresh: in a scratch venv run `pip install build hatchling`, `pip freeze`,
# copy the new versions here, then run the check. It is safe to bump: the check
# compares two builds made with the SAME pins, never against older releases.
build==1.6.1
hatchling==1.32.3
packaging==26.3
pathspec==1.1.1
pluggy==1.6.0
pyproject_hooks==1.3.3
tomlkit==0.15.1
trove-classifiers==2026.6.1.19
# Conditional dependencies of the two tools above.
colorama==0.4.6; os_name == "nt"
tomli==2.4.1; python_version < "3.11"
importlib-metadata==8.7.1; python_full_version < "3.10.2"
zipp==3.23.1; python_full_version < "3.10.2"
